facts.business: Mitshi India Limited is focusing on software business and exploring opportunities in agro-based products, e-commerce, and logistics to build a multi-pronged business model.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Management intends to focus more on business of Software during the year besides its regular operations
Mitshi India is exploring opportunities beyond its traditional domains, including agro-based products, e-commerce, and logistics, aiming to build a more resilient and multi-pronged business model

key_risks: Return on capital employed has been falling, pointing to inefficient capital utilization
Larger players in agri-trading and tech services may challenge market share
Cyclical demand and pricing in principal markets
Economic developments within India and countries where the Company conducts business
